user.title: Connect Soniox
user.description: Create a project and API key at console.soniox.com. The region must match the project's data residency.

error.invalid_auth: Soniox rejected this API key (for this region).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Soniox entry is supported.

data_description.language: Automatic follows the Assist pipeline language; a fixed language is sent as a strict hint.
data_description.context_terms: Names, products and commands that are often misheard, comma or newline separated. Sent as Soniox context.terms.
data_description.context_text: Background text describing the domain, sent as Soniox context.text.
data_description.speaker_id_url: Optional. A pyannote-style endpoint that receives the utterance as WAV and returns {speaker, confidence}. The transcript is prefixed with [Speaker: NAME].
data_description.speaker_threshold: Minimum confidence before the speaker prefix is added.
data_description.tts_voice: Every Soniox voice speaks every supported language.
data_description.tts_emotion: Soniox audio tag placed before every message, e.g. [warm] or [excited]. Inline tags in the message itself always win. neutral = none.
